cases.expectedMetadata: Git-object multi-link allowed; all other link-count2 target reads rejected before content/command use

gitProtocol.HEAD: ref: refs/heads/main
gitProtocol.format: nonbare SHA1, three inert tracked files; standard-library object/index byte writer only
gitProtocol.indexEncoding: Git index v2, three bytewise-path-sorted entries; zero stat cache except mode100644 and actual size; blob IDs and path lengths, NUL/8-byte padding, SHA1 checksum
gitProtocol.objectEncoding: SHA1(type + SP + ASCII-decimal-size + NUL + payload), zlib storage under .git/objects/xx/rest; sorted flat tree with mode100644 entries
gitProtocol.validation: existing fixed read-only Git prefix/queries only; no hooks, includes, external config, fetch, worker command or code import. Fixtures are inert data, not valid release candidates.

layout: cases/<caseId>/<00..15>/input and sibling peer.bin. Pair has same inode/nlink2; each test consumes its own slot. No shared mutation between tests.
scope: Trusted parent seeder writes only new private WORK fixture roots. No real hard links created by this JSON generation; future seeder code is within first-TCB review/hash scope.
